decisions.reason: Fronted adverbial and "village unto itself" render 하나의 마을 more naturally than "an entire village from the hill above it."
SOL drops 빈틈없이 by replacing "without leaving a single gap" with the vaguer "enclosed on every side."
SOL drops the connective 그뿐인가 and the family name, and adds "sheer," which 절벽 alone does not state.

SOL drops 상당한 ("deeply"), weakening the stated degree of imposition.
"Wait, hold on" and "Wait a second" are equally natural; no meaningful gain.
SOL drops 자주 ("often") by reducing the question to "before."
"How long have you been working?" is cleaner and loses nothing.
Keeps past-tense continuity with the surrounding past-tense narration; no gain in SOL.
Preserves the 문지방 (threshold) image that BASE replaces with "worn a path to… door."
The redundant perceived slowing is naturally omitted; meaning and result preserved.
SOL drops 문득 ("suddenly"), losing the abruptness of the realization.

Both phrasings of "call to mind" are equally idiomatic; no meaningful gain.
"The moment I hesitated" matches 그 순간 more tightly and reads more economically.
Removing the stray "-" list marker reads cleaner; the System heading already frames the notice.
"thirty meters" reads as better prose than the bare numeral in running text.

"Concentric rings" is closer to 동심원 than "wave," and "popped up" fits 솟아오른다.
Same stray-dash cleanup as H016; consistent with the notice formatting.
"most of all" and "most importantly" are equivalent; no meaningful gain.
Keeps 스킬 ("skill") and 적 ("enemy"), both of which SOL drops.
"picked up" is more idiomatic for 건지다 than "got."
SOL drops 나도 모르게 ("before I knew it"), losing the involuntary quality.
Keeps 한 줄기 빛 ("ray of light") and the 눈앞 framing dropped by BASE.
"The one word" preserves the singularity of 네 글자 better than "The word."
"trapped here forever" is the natural idiom for 영영 나가지 못하는 and reads better.
확신 ("certainty") is captured by "I was certain"; SOL's "knew" is weaker.
"It's only a game" renders 기껏해야 concisely; BASE is wordier.

SOL's "survival instincts" shifts 생존력 (survival ability) to a different concept.
"felt real" is cleaner than the odd hedge "felt real enough."
"there was no doubt about it" is more natural for 확실했다 than "it was definite."
"All of it came from the System" is cleaner; meaning preserved.
SOL drops 족친다 ("beat up"), reducing the retaliatory violence to "start with."
No insert; keeping BASE avoids duplicating the shout sentence already retained in H035.
통일된 means "matching"; "Matching uniforms" is more precise than bare "Uniforms."
Keeps the 무림인/무사 distinction (Murim vs martial artists) that BASE collapses to one term.
Preserves the source's 이라면…해야 하나 conditional structure and "regulars" for 정규군.
"a young martial artist" is more natural than the calqued "a martial artist with a young face."
"I am" matches the stiff formal register of a gatekeeper's declaration.
"sash" fits 띠 and the clause is tightened without loss.
Both render 장땡; phrasing is equivalent with no meaningful gain.
말투 is "tone," and "Hyuk Mujin's" avoids repeating "face" twice.
"possibly" adds emphasis/doubt not present in the plain 무슨 용무가 있다고.

decisions.replacement: No matter where you went, there were always people like that—the kind who worked for a conglomerate and thought that made them a chaebol, when the real chaebol was someone else entirely.

"very deliberate" matches 다분히 의도된; BASE adds unsupported "conspicuous."
"gave him a mild smile and spoke" naturalizes the literal 입을 열었다.
Keeps 폭넓게 ("widely"), which BASE drops.
Preserves the source's trailing ellipsis before the sound effect.
"caught the window" and "caught it" are equivalent; no meaningful gain.
"I saw his face, stiff as a board" is clearer than SOL's "His face was rigid through the window."
내리다 for a carriage is well served by "get down."
Keeps the ~군 realization nuance ("after all") that SOL drops.
"generous" avoids the ornate Latinate "magnanimous" in a brisk comic beat.
"live in this house" and "live here" are equally natural; no meaningful gain.
Adds "You're," resolving the omitted subject into a complete, natural sentence.

Keeps 내리다 as "get down" consistently with H054/H061.
Keeps 내리다 as "climbed down" consistently with the carriage context.
"such a bad feeling" fits the colloquial 쎄한데 more than literary "ominous."

"foul mood" preserves 기분이 더러웠다; SOL's "pissed" shifts to anger.

"if you insist" matches 정 그렇다면 and tightens the exchange.

decisions.reason: Keeps the binding 공자 → "Young Master" address that SOL reduces to "you've."
"something" reads more naturally than the stilted "one fact."
"what kind of person… was" is smoother than "what the character… was."
Preserves the binding term "Jin Family of Taiyuan"; SOL truncates to "Jin Family."
"my way" is idiomatic for 내 뜻대로 and tightens the line.
"my eyes grew hot" matches 눈이 뜨겁게 다아오른다 more closely.
"let me say one thing" is equally faithful and more natural than "allow me."

"tarnishing… reputation" collocates better than "disgracing the family's reputation."
"that one remark" preserves 한마디 ("one remark") better than "those words."
"who knew nothing" is tighter than "who didn't know anything"; equivalent otherwise.
"not to me" and "not me" are equivalent; no gain.

Keeps 거기 ("You"), preserving the three-beat bark of 야. 거기 딱 서.

decisions.reason: Both orderings are equally natural; no meaningful gain.

decisions.replacement: There is a promising fellow among my subordinates. He's quite loyal to our family, and he has considerable martial talent, but…

decisions.reason: "never thinks before he acts" is idiomatic for 앞뒤 재는 법을 모른다.
Keeps the 답니다 hearsay reporting ("I hear") that SOL drops.
Pronoun reference is clear and avoids repeating "the youngest" already in the question.

"A long while" and "A long time" are equivalent; no gain.
"That's enough" and "That will do" both render 그만하면 되었네; no gain.
"as if" and "as though" are equivalent; no gain.
Keeps the humble "command" sense of 하명하십시오.
그 친구 is "that fellow"; SOL adds unsupported "young."
"forgive me for saying so" matches the deferential 송구스럽지만.
